Class Event

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.entities.card.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.model.entities.card.types.event.Event
Direct Known Subclasses:
Feast, Hunt, Ritual, StonePainting
public abstract class Event extends Card
Abstract base class for event cards.

Event cards are not drawn into a player's hand; instead, they are resolved collectively at the end of a round or age, affecting all players at once. The four concrete event types are Feast, Hunt, Ritual, and StonePainting, each implementing execEvent(List, GamePhaseEnum) with their own resolution logic.
